metadata.question: Were black carbon AODs near the east of Australia, specifically within a 100km radius about (-34.344553, 157.706220), up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Collection: MERRA-2 "M2T1NXAER" asset (provides black carbon absorption optical depth)
   - Band: BCAOD550 (black carbon absorption AOD)
   - Date ranges: 
       - "Nov-2019 to Feb-2020" -> 2019-11-01 ... 2020-02-29
       - "same time prior year" -> 2018-11-01 ... 2019-02-28
   - Location: 100 km buffer around Point(-34.344553, 157.706220) off-eastern Australia

2. Masking:
   - MERRA-2 reanalysis has no clouds/instrument gaps; select band, clip to region.

3. Logic:
   - Compute spatial mean for each Nov-Feb window.
   - Compare 2019/20 mean vs 2018/19 mean to see if it went up (>)
   - If any collection size == 0 -> C1; if valid-pixel count == 0 -> C2; if result None/NaN -> C3; else answer A/B.
</thinking>

```python
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1 Geometry & time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([157.706220, -34.344553])
roi = pt.buffer(100000)  # 100 km

date_sets = [
    ('2019-11-01', '2020-02-29'),  # 2019/20 season
    ('2018-11-01', '2019-02-28'),  # 2018/19 season
]

values = []
for start, end in date_sets:
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/MERRA2/M2T1NXAER')
           .select('BCAOD550')
           .filterDate(start, end))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{start[:4]} images: 0")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    mean = (col.mean()
            .multiply(0.001)  # scale to optical depth
            .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                          geometry=roi,
                          scale=3000,
                          maxPixels=1e9)
            .get('BCAOD550')
            .getInfo())
    pix = (col.first()
           .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                         geometry=roi,
                         scale=3000,
                         maxPixels=1e9)
           .get('BCAOD550')
           .getInfo())
    if mean is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        exit()
    if pix == 0:
        print("No valid pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    print(f"{start[:4]} BCAOD: {mean:.3f}, pixels: {int(pix)}")
    values.append(mean)

print(f"Change {values[0]:.3f} vs {values[1]:.3f}")
print(f"Up? {values[0] > values[1]}")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if values[0] > values[1] else "<answer>B</answer>")
```
